findings: LDraw's current Minifig category query returns 4,340 records, confirming that full ingestion must distinguish patterns/assemblies from unique physical moulds.
A June 2026 LDraw census estimated 960 torso records, 398 leg records, 144 hip records, 78 arm records, 5 hand records, roughly 792 heads, and large headwear/accessory families.
LDraw's approved category vocabulary now includes granular Minifig Head/Upper/Lower/Leg/Hips/Arm/Hand/Torso/Body/Assembly/Accessory categories.
Rebrickable documents direct LDraw/BrickLink/BrickOwl color mappings plus external part IDs and part relationships, making it a key reconciliation source.
LDraw !COLOUR explicitly models alpha, luminance and multiple finishes/materials; AI rendering must preserve these semantics rather than flattening all colors to hex.
